summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Tencent Music Entertainment Group announcing the record date for its annual general meeting of shareholders. The filing provides administrative details for holders of Class A and Class B ordinary shares and ADSs to attend and vote at the AGM. There are no special-situation corporate actions, deal terms, or strategic changes described. The filing is a standard regulatory notice and does not involve acquisitions, divestitures, or any other special-situation category listed in the classification schema.
